mustSurvive: Every change MUST have one approving review before it merges.
1. Open the change with `mcp__example__open_change` and read the description first.
2. Run the checks from src/ci/checks.ts and wait for them to finish.
3. Reply within 30 min during working hours; otherwise reassign the review.
NEVER approve a change you have not run locally.
The call mcp__example__request_changes records the reason in the thread.
Comments longer than 20 lines belong in a document, not in the review.
